def choose_next_customer(

    available_customers: np.ndarray,     # (n_available, 2) revealed unserved customers

thought: For each available customer, compute the truck's new return time if it serves that customer and then returns to depot. Compare with the current maximum return time of other trucks (their distances to depot). If there exists a customer where the new return time does not exceed the current max, choose the one that minimizes the new return time. Otherwise, choose the customer that minimizes the increase in the max return time. This greedy minimizes the immediate impact on the last-truck return time.
